Prisidio review: digital legacy verdict

Verdict: A family 'life readiness' vault with a Co-Owner and a Keyholder who can get the vault after a verified death, with identity checks via CLEAR. Best for: US households who want one shared vault for documents, valuables and stories.

Key facts

  • Category: Estate & document tools
  • Pricing: Check current pricing.
  • Best for: US households who want one shared vault for documents, valuables and stories.
  • Co-Owner plus Keyholder handover model
  • CLEAR identity verification for designees (added May 2026)

Official site / docs ↗

What are the pros and cons of Prisidio?

Pros

  • Co-Owner plus Keyholder handover model
  • CLEAR identity verification for designees (added May 2026)
  • Activity log and reminders for expiring documents

Cons

  • After release, Keyholders get time-limited, view/download-only access (one year, per Prisidio's terms)
  • US-focused identity verification

Estate & document tools

Popular online tool for US wills and trusts with guided questions. Not built for Australian or most non-US jurisdictions.

Estate & document tools

GoodTrust

An all-in-one US estate planning platform: will, trust and directives (valid in all 50 states) plus a Digital Vault for your digital life.

Estate & document tools

Everplans

A well-structured digital vault for life admin and end-of-life plans that you can securely share with people you trust.
